minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, August 21, 2019
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, August 21, 2019.
  Members present: Terry Kistler, Lorraine Missick, Scott Snider, George Borst and
  Bette Donovan
  Members absent: Chick Campo
  Staff Present: Bill Aguirre, Staff Laison, Yvonne Duran, Recreation Coordinator, and
  Brandon Granillo, Recreation Coordinator
  Guests Present: Emily Turner, La Verne resident.
2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Nutrition Program: The average meals served for July was 35 and for August was
  also 35.

4. Meals on Wheels: In May, 56 meals were delivered to participants with a total of 779
  meals. In June, 48 meals were delivered to participants with a total of 796 meals. In
  July, 51 meals were delivered to participants with a total of 892 meals.

5. Bingo Report: George gave reports for March, April, May, June, and July. The totals
  for July are: Beginning balance was $3,330. Ending balance was $3,075 change
  was $254. Average of 54 players for the July session. Expenses paid by check
  $259.64:

  We will be advertising in the Bingo Bugle starting in September for a cost of $189
  per month for 3 months. Currently, there are financial issues. Paper is more costly.
  $325 was paid to the bank in the last 2 weeks. Additionally, we are projected to lose
  $600 in August. Average attendance is down to 45 players, changes need to be
  made to increase participation. Complaints include, long line to pay before Bingo
  begins.

  Attendance for December-March was 58 and the attendance for April-July was 53.
  Need 60 people in attendance to break even.
   A motion was made to stop the hall charges for Bingo for the rest of the year. It was
  moved and seconded. Motion approved to stop the Bingo Program charges for hall
  rental for September, October, November, and December.

6. Account Balance: To date, account balance is $3,816.66.

7. Fee Schedule for Use of the Facilities: Senior Pinochle has not paid for July.

New Business

8. Upcoming Events:
  Friday, September 6th – La Verne Day at the LA County Fair, all day
  Saturday, October 19th – Halloween Parade at CVS Plaza, 10:00 AM
  Wednesday, October 30th – Health and Resource Fair, 9:00 AM - 11:30 AM
  Thursday, October 31st – Special City Sponsored Lunch (Halloween Theme), 11:30
  AM

9. Facilities Report: Veteran’s Hall is having work done on the roof. Community Center
  needs new control panel for the air conditioning unit. The senior craft room in the
  community center has been painted and walls are finished. Oak Mesa is painting the
  building and replacing rotten wood. Now, they are waiting on quotes for roofing. City
  Hall installed a new generator in the event of a power outage.

10. Public Comments: Emily Turner asked about the Meals on Wheels program.
  Brandon talked about the Line Dancing Event at the Community Center and said the
  next Line Dancing Event will be held sometime in February. Starting in September,
  we will be charging 50 cents per person to attend Line Dancing courses that occur
  each Monday and Tuesday. A senior guitar class is also being chartered at the
  Community Center, although, they are in need of an instructor. A ukulele class is a
  possible course idea for the future.

  Scott announced the Country Fair at Hillcrest will be on Saturday, October 12 th.
  Chamber of Commerce, Wednesday, October 16 th, Taste of La Verne at Bracket
  Field.
  George gave an update on the Golf program. The number of players has increased
  to 20. Sierra La Verne is closed. They will probably have one session at San Dimas
  Canyon and one session at Marshall Canyon. Cost for seniors with county card is
  $28.75 and $37.00 at San Dimas Canyon, which includes breakfast or lunch. The
  kitchen closes at 2:00 PM so George will let everyone know. The Marshall Canyon
  course is better now since it has been renovated. Most of the players want to go to
  Marshall Canyon.
 11. Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:55 AM. Motion approved. The next
  meeting will be Wednesday, September 18, 2019 at 10:00 AM.
